count_fields.waiting_running_scheduled_total: Each queue row uses Buildkite cluster metrics when count_source is cluster_metrics; otherwise counts are derived from fetched active jobs. Queue-native counts include zombies.
count_fields.zombie_waiting_zombie_running: Derived from fetched active jobs and reported separately from queue-native counts.

wait_fields.official_wait: Buildkite queue-native waitTimeSec converted to minutes; contains only p50, p95, and max.
wait_fields.sample_wait: Exact statistics in minutes from fetched, currently SCHEDULED, non-zombie jobs; available records whether that queue's jobs were fetched, and count is null when they were not.
wait_fields.current_wait: Displayed p50, p95, and p99 values paired with their per-field source labels.
wait_fields.p50_wait: official_wait.p50 when available, otherwise sample_wait.p50, otherwise null.
wait_fields.p95_wait: official_wait.p95 when available, otherwise sample_wait.p95, otherwise null.
wait_fields.p99_wait: sample_wait.p99 when sampled jobs are available, otherwise null.
wait_fields.p75_wait_p90_wait_avg_wait: Sample-only compatibility fields; null without sampled jobs.
wait_fields.max_wait: official_wait.max when available, otherwise sample_wait.max, otherwise null.
wait_fields.field_source_labels: Each root wait field has a matching *_wait_source value of official_wait, sample_wait, or null.
